_comment: PatchTST settings for the ALL-MODEL ROLLING-ORIGIN COMPARISON (scripts/run_rolling_comparison.py). Identical to config/patchtst_lr1e-4_experiment.json (lr 1e-4, context 96, patch 16, stride 8, 3 layers, d_model 64, patience 8) with ONE difference: rolling_origin.max_epochs = 60, the same epoch cap as the single-split lr 1e-4 experiment (the generic config caps rolling folds at 40, which would truncate a lr 1e-4 run whose best epoch was 31 of 39). Early stopping (patience 8) on each fold's validation block still decides the real number of epochs. 'horizons' is ignored by the comparison script (use --horizons). Nothing here is tuned on test data.
